description: Stage Two feature artifact contract for feature Parquet outputs and PostgreSQL catalog registration.

feature_groups.name: dns_features
feature_groups.description: DNS lexical, packet, resolver, and domain-level features derived from normalized DNS events.

feature_groups.name: host_syscall_features
feature_groups.description: Host syscall/API sequence and aggregate features derived from normalized syscall or sandbox events.

feature_groups.name: host_eventlog_features
feature_groups.description: Host event log, auth, process, and file activity features.

feature_groups.name: host_metrics_features
feature_groups.description: Host metric features derived from Metricbeat-like CPU, memory, filesystem, network, and service telemetry.

feature_groups.name: network_flow_features
feature_groups.description: Packet, flow, NetFlow, and network summary features.

feature_groups.name: hybrid_features
feature_groups.description: Cross-domain host plus DNS/network correlation features.

feature_groups.name: sequence_features
feature_groups.description: Ordered event/window features for sequence models with event UID traceability.

catalog_registration.large_feature_rows_storage: Parquet only; PostgreSQL stores metadata and artifact paths.

null_policy.missing_feature_values: Use Parquet null for missing feature values.
null_policy.labels: Labels may be present for y/analysis, but all label columns are excluded from X model features.
null_policy.splits: TRAIN, VALIDATION, TEST, and EXPERIMENTS remain physically partitioned by role.
